references.text: Joshua mentions Kinnereth as one of the fortified cities in the territory of the tribe of Naphtali, confirming its geographical location by the Sea of Galilee.
The Sea of Kinnereth (Sea of Galilee) is mentioned in connection with Israel's crossing of the Jordan, marking the eastern boundary of the Promised Land.
Kinnereth is mentioned as part of the area given to the tribe of Gad, with reference to the sea as a geographical marker.
Kinnereth is listed among the areas conquered under Joshua's leadership, confirming its significance in the description of borders.
Kinnereth is mentioned in connection with Ben-Hadad's conquest of areas in Israel, showing the continued geographical importance of this place.
The Sea of Galilee (Kinnereth) is the place where Jesus began his ministry, highlighting the ongoing significance of this region in biblical history.
The Sea of Galilee (Kinnereth) is mentioned in connection with Jesus' teaching, linking the New Testament to the geographical location found in Numbers.
